A malformed data URI with extract_images enabled produces an ImageExtractionFailed warning

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>Text<img src=\"data:BADMIME\" alt=\"broken\">end</p>", new ConversionOptions { ExtractImages = true });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
Console.WriteLine(result.Warnings);
```
